text: 财政部会计司司长林启云在财政部新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期将更加注重法治与监督，财会监督体系是重要抓手。一方面把尺子打准，系统推进会计准则等标准，加快完善注册会计师行业配套制度；另一方面把规矩守严，建设协同高效的会计监督体系，全链条依法重拳惩治财务报表和审计违法违规行为，维护市场经济秩序。
text_en: Lin Qiyun, Director of the Accounting Department of the Ministry of Finance, said at a Ministry of Finance press conference that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, greater emphasis will be placed on the rule of law and supervision, with the accounting supervision system as an important lever. On the one hand, standards will be applied accurately by systematically advancing accounting standards and other norms and accelerating the improvement of supporting systems for the certified public accountant industry; on the other hand, rules will be strictly enforced by building a coordinated and efficient accounting supervision system, severely punishing violations of laws and regulations in financial statements and auditing across the entire chain in accordance with the law, and safeguarding the order of the market economy.
